toolSettings.title: Built-in tools
toolSettings.description: Per-category toggles for the in-process cognia-tools MCP server. Each category exposes a different set of tools to the agent.
toolSettings.permissionsDesc: Tools that require approval pop up a per-call dialog. Add a tool to the always-allow list (below) to skip the prompt. Disable a category to remove its tools from the agent entirely.
toolSettings.desktopRequiredDesc: These tools run inside the local sidecar process. They are unavailable in the web build.
toolSettings.fileExtrasDesc: hash, diff, content_search, file_info and other ops not covered by the SDK's built-in Read / Write / Glob / Grep.
toolSettings.gitOperationsDesc: Structured wrappers for git status, diff, log, branch, remote, tag, and repo inspection. Read-only.
toolSettings.processManagementDesc: List, search, start and terminate local processes. Off by default — start/terminate are high-risk.
toolSettings.environmentManagementDesc: Read environment variables and system info. Secret-shaped keys (KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD) are redacted unless the agent explicitly opts in.
toolSettings.shellExecutionDesc: Allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard for shell commands. Off by default — overlaps SDK Bash and is high-risk.
toolSettings.alwaysAllowDesc: Tools the user has approved across the board. Future calls skip the approval dialog.
toolSettings.alwaysAllowEmpty: No tools have been added to the always-allow list yet.

tools.fileHash: Compute md5 / sha1 / sha256 / sha512 of a file. Read-only.
tools.fileSearch: List files under a directory matching an optional glob and extension filter.
tools.contentSearch: Search file contents (substring or regex) with line numbers.
tools.fileExists: Check if a path exists. Returns isFile / isDirectory.
tools.fileAppend: Append UTF-8 text to a file. Creates the file if missing.
tools.fileBinaryWrite: Write a base64-encoded binary payload to a file.
tools.fileMove: Move a file across or within filesystems.
tools.directoryDelete: Delete a directory. Recursive option for non-empty trees.
tools.gitDiff: Diff working tree or staged area.
tools.gitLog: Recent commits with hash / author / date / subject.
tools.gitTag: List tags, optionally filtered by glob.
tools.gitRepoInspect: Top-level path, current branch, HEAD hash, upstream.
tools.gitHistory: Commit history for a path or set of paths.
tools.getProcess: Get a single process by PID.
tools.searchProcesses: Find processes whose name contains a substring.
tools.topMemoryProcesses: Top N processes by resident memory.
tools.checkProgramAllowed: Test whether a program would be allowed to start_process.
tools.getProcessManagerStatus: Sidecar process manager state and tracked PID count.
tools.getTrackedProcesses: PIDs the agent has started this session.
tools.startProcess: Start a program from the allowlist. Requires approval.
tools.terminateProcess: Terminate a PID (default: only PIDs this session started).
tools.listEnv: List process env vars. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.getEnv: Read a single env var. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.systemInfo: Platform, arch, node version, cpu, memory, uptime, hostname.
tools.shellExecuteAdvanced: Run a single program with argv, gated by allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard. Always requires approval.
